title: readSealedDeviceSession
responsibility: Reads a signed-in installation’s stage and proves possession of its enrolled signing key to the Hub.

inputs.name: readSealedDeviceSession.request
inputs.description: Same-origin transport backed by the current Google session and restricted to the sealed sync API.

inputs.name: readSealedDeviceSession.device
inputs.description: The current installation’s public identity and nonextractable signing key for its Hub challenge.

inputs.name: readSealedDeviceSession.signal
inputs.description: Cancels the Hub calls and prevents a proof from being sent for a superseded session.

outputs.name: readSealedDeviceSession
outputs.description: Returns the first-device, waiting-for-approval or approved stage. Completes the same-session signing challenge when required.

errors.name: SealedError
errors.description: The Hub refused the request, provided an invalid stage or challenge, or did not confirm the signed proof.
